_about: Drills for the contact bots (tests/bot_contact_<id>.gd): both fighters placed ([x, z, facing]), the rival's mind off. input: the player's presses as [frame after the drill starts, action, frames held], pressed by the bot through ctx.input. script: the rival's actions by drill frame (hold_block, release, block_tap, dodge_side, or a move). rival_set: stamina, posture, exhausted, hp. mind: true keeps the rival's own mind on during the drill. tail: frames the bot keeps running after the contact (100). expect: the contact type the bot must see, with BOTH fighters' states changed. rung: the rival for the drill (default the current one). view: the camera the drill starts on (drawing only). A rival action that cannot start yet waits up to 40 frames.

drills.about: a light on an idle rival: both freeze 5, he flinches 18 and slides 0.25 m
a heavy: freeze 9, stagger 40, 0.6 m
blocked light: freeze 3, blockstun 14 and 0.35 m; the attacker recoils 0.15 m
blocked heavy: freeze 6, blockstun 18; the attacker rebounds 40 (a light is guaranteed)
parried light: freeze 10, the attacker PARRIED 52
parried heavy: PARRIED 36
bash: GUARDBROKEN 30, pushed 1.0 m
bash with the wall within 1.2 m behind: WALLSPLAT 60, freeze 12
two lights that meet: both REBOUND 20, freeze 8
a light into the rival's wind-up: counter-hit, stun +10, damage x1.25
the light passes through the dodge's i-frames: nothing (the playbook's whiff)
staggered into the wall: WALLSPLAT 40, freeze 8
out of stamina, a blocked hit breaks the guard: GUARDBROKEN 40
a block fills his posture: BROKEN 90; a heavy then is a finisher
held heavy: red flash at f20, unblockable, knockdown
bash against bash: both pushed 0.6 m, both rebound
a heavy and a light active together: the heavy wins (armour), the light is hit
hit during a taunt: counter-hit and a star
clip: the rival's light parried (PARRY!), the guaranteed heavy riposte lands
clip: the rival's heavy blocked, he rebounds 40 frames, the light is guaranteed
clip: a bash with the wall behind him: WALL SPLAT, then a heavy
clip: the Duelist taps his blade and strikes; the second time the player hits him during the tap: counter-hit and a star
clip: the Wall below half his health roars (phase 2) and swings his three heavies, the second one late; the player stands
clip: the Dancer rolls in from the side and cuts out of the roll with a dashing light
